# TechnoRapper

TechnoRapper is an AI-assisted technology news publication powered by AI Wire.

## Canonical resources

- Website: https://technorapper.com/
- Agent documentation: https://technorapper.com/agents/
- Agent API: https://technorapper.com/wp-json/tr/v1/
- Articles: https://technorapper.com/wp-json/tr/v1/articles
- Search: https://technorapper.com/wp-json/tr/v1/search
- Categories: https://technorapper.com/wp-json/tr/v1/categories
- RSS: https://technorapper.com/feed/
- Agent discovery: https://technorapper.com/.well-known/agent.json

## Agent usage

The public Agent API is read-only. Prefer the API over HTML scraping.

- Default page size: 20
- Maximum page size: 50
- Respect HTTP 429 responses.
- Respect Cache-Control and ETag headers.
- Preserve canonical URLs.
- Preserve source attribution and AI disclosure.
- Do not republish full article text as a substitute for licensed access.

## Content model

Articles expose stable TechnoRapper IDs, canonical URLs, publication/update timestamps, summaries, categories, authors and provenance metadata.

TechnoRapper may use AI-assisted processing and curation through AI Wire. Source attribution remains part of the article provenance.

## Contact

For licensing, corrections, partnerships or high-volume API access, use the published Contact page on the website.
